title: Workstream A: AU-RCC Inference Semantics Correction & Separation
objective: Disentangle descriptive numerical AU-RCC effect from inferential tier-level Balanced Accuracy hypothesis tests, and officially retire the misleading label STATISTICALLY_SUPERIOR for AU-RCC.

mathematical_distinction.integrated_aurcc_estimand: AU-RCC = (1 / 0.8) * integral_{0.2}^{1.0} Risk(kappa) d_kappa. Computed deterministically via trapezoidal numerical quadrature. No direct inferential hypothesis test was conducted on this integral.
mathematical_distinction.tier_level_ba_estimand: Pointwise hypothesis test H0: BA_conf(kappa) <= BA_rand(kappa) evaluated at discrete coverage levels kappa in {0.2, 0.3, ..., 0.8}. Inferential statements apply strictly to the tested coverage tiers, not to the functional integral across all coverage.
mathematical_distinction.discontinuation_notice: The classification STATISTICALLY_SUPERIOR is permanently discontinued because it conflated pointwise coverage-tier Balanced Accuracy hypothesis tests with integrated AU-RCC performance.

BTCUSDT.class_support_rationale: Minority class support exceeds 50 observations at coverage kappa=0.20 across all folds.
BTCUSDT.semantic_governance_rule: AU-RCC was calculated via deterministic numerical integration. Rejecting H0: BA_conf(kappa) <= BA_rand(kappa) at coverage tiers [] provides tier-level BA evidence only and does NOT establish statistical superiority of the integrated AU-RCC metric.
